## v0.21

- Controls: L1, L2, R1 and R2 can all be assigned to any Zodiac button. L2 and R2 are detected even when the device reports them as analog trigger axes instead of key presses (press the trigger when a row says "Press a button…").
- Shoulder and trigger buttons (and every other gamepad button) are now always handled by ZodiacDroid and never passed on to Android, so L1 no longer starts Bluetooth discovery. A pad button with no assignment now does nothing.
- Not verified on a device.
